name: compaction_handoff
description: Keeps a long-lived Claude Code session's work across context compaction. From a configured share of the expected compaction point the agent is asked to write a handoff to L2 with context_save (in progress, next step, open items), recognised by a name prefix and the session id in its frontmatter. A Claude Code mod (mod/, loaded with claude --plugin-dir) drives the cycle: it asks for the handoff as a turn of its own, compacts right after that turn, then asks the session to read the handoff back. Three hooks stay as insurance: each turn start repeats the request, every compaction leaves a fallback record with figures only (no conversation text) and holds off one auto-compaction per cycle without a fresh handoff, and after every compaction the session is told which handoff to read. Claude Code formats live in hooks/ and mod/; L2 is read and written through KairosChain's own context interface (hooks/probe.rb for the mod). Design: log/compaction_handoff_design_v0.4.md (KairosChain repository).
author: Masaomi Hatakeyama
